messages.subject: For Goh Choon Phong | Global aviation, sustainability and government stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Singapore Airlines Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Goh Choon Phong, Chief Executive Officer.

Singapore Airlines' global network requires disciplined alignment across governments, aviation authorities, airports, sustainability priorities and strategic partners. That interface closely matches my current experience.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, corporate affairs, ESG, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, including coordination with aviation and other public authorities.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, aviation coordination and sustainability stakeholder strategy might support Singapore Airlines' priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Singapore Airlines.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
